svg.text: metres from the crossroads; the dashed diamond is what the overview shows
orthographic, camera 48.6° above the horizon, so the main streets run corner to corner
The enemy town: walls 156 m across, four gates, all shut; a siege mound against its south-east face. Round it the besiegers'
double wall (as at Plataea); the camps lie outside it, north (the commander's), east, south and west, joined only by the walk
between its two walls, so every message between camps goes the long way round.
